name: Philadelphia Parks & Rec Visual Arts Summer Camp
description_short: Six week visual arts day camp for Philadelphia children ages 6 to 12, taught by working artists at three city park and rec sites. Each week campers spend two days painting or drawing and two days on sculpture, try photography, and go on field trips; breakfast and lunch are served. Open to Philadelphia residents only.

sessions.name: Summer art camp, Monday to Friday 9:00 to 3:00

notes: 2026: July 6 to August 14, 9:00 to 3:00, $350, limited fee waivers and scholarships. Philadelphia residents only. Three sites with the same dates and ages: Fisher Park, 571 W Spencer St (19120); Rivera Recreation Center, 3201 N 5th St (19140); McCreesh Playground, 6744 Regent St (19142). The address shown is Fisher Park. Register by email to Christine.Rad@Phila.gov or PPRVisualArts@phila.gov. 2027 not yet posted.
